ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the course-design request is open-ended generative work (structuring subtopics, listing skills, recommending courses) with broad latitude rather than a tightly-specified extraction/reformatting task. Avocet self-reports an aversion to exactly this kind of high-latitude generative work, whereas Plover does not. On top of that, Plover has stronger or tied internal eval scores across every category and higher public benchmarks, so it's the safer pick for quality regardless of preference. Note the documented caveat that these preferences don't actually correlate with output quality — but since Plover both prefers (relatively) and benchmarks better here, there's no tradeoff to weigh.
